common.loadErrorDescription: The device didn't answer. Check that it's on and on the same network, then try again.

home.label: Home
home.description: Mute your cameras for a while

nvr.label: NVR
nvr.description: Address and login of the Reolink NVR

backendErrors.device_busy: The device is busy with something else. Wait a few seconds and try again.
backendErrors.nvr_not_configured: The NVR is not set up yet. Enter its address, username and password in the NVR page first.
backendErrors.invalid_nvr_field: The device didn't accept the NVR address, username or password. Check them and try again. The address and the password can be up to 64 characters, the username up to 32.
backendErrors.nvr_change_while_muted: The NVR login can't change while quiet mode is on or the alerts are still off. Turn the alerts back on first, then try again.
backendErrors.nvr_save_failed: The device could not save the NVR login. Please try again.

home.title: Quiet mode

idle.title: Alerts on
idle.description: Your cameras are recording and notifying you as usual.

running.title: Quiet mode
running.description: left before the alerts come back on their own

alertsOff.title: Alerts still off
alertsOff.description: Quiet mode is over, but your cameras are not alerting you yet.

home.busy: The device is working, one moment...

alertsOff.title: Your cameras may not be alerting you
alertsOff.description: The device couldn't turn the alerts back on. Check that the NVR is switched on and reachable, then hold the button on the switch to try again.

setup.title: Set up your NVR first
setup.description: The switch needs the address and the login of your Reolink NVR before it can mute your cameras.

buttonHelp.title: On the switch
buttonHelp.hint: This page only shows the status. The quiet mode starts and stops only with the button on the switch.

shortPress.label: Short press
shortPress.description: Choose how long the quiet mode lasts.

longPress.label: Hold the button
longPress.description: Start the quiet mode, or cancel it while it is running.

nvr.title: NVR
nvr.loginDescription: The address and the account of your Reolink NVR on your home network.

host.label: NVR address
host.note: The IP address or the name of the NVR. If you paste it with http:// in front, the device removes it.

password.label: Password
password.note: The password of that NVR account.
password.savedNote: A password is saved. Leave this empty to keep it, or type a new one.
password.clearedNote: The saved password was deleted because the address or the username changed. Type the password of this NVR.

nvr.saveSuccess: The login has been saved. The device is checking it now.
nvr.saveError: An error occurred while saving the NVR login

locked.title: The login is locked for now
locked.description: While quiet mode is on, or the alerts are still off, the device needs the saved login to turn them back on. Cancel quiet mode or wait for it to end, make sure the alerts are on again, then change the login.

nvr.connectionDescription: Whether the device can reach the NVR with this login.

checking.title: Checking the NVR...
checking.description: The device is logging in and counting the online cameras.

notConfigured.title: Not set up yet
notConfigured.description: Save the address, the username and the password to connect to the NVR.

unknown.title: Not checked yet
unknown.description: Press Test connection to check that the device can reach the NVR.

connected.title: Connected: {count} camera online | Connected: {count} cameras online
connected.description: The device logged in to the NVR and can mute it.

unreachable.title: The NVR doesn't answer
unreachable.description: Check the address, and that the NVR is on and on the same network as the switch.

loginRefused.title: The NVR refused the login
loginRefused.description: Check the username and the password.

loginPaused.title: Login paused
loginPaused.description: The NVR locks the account after a few wrong passwords, so the device waits 10 minutes before it tries again. Check the username and the password and save them again, or just wait 10 minutes.

nvr.testError: The device couldn't run the test. Please try again.

changeDialog.title: Change the NVR?
changeDialog.description: The saved password only works for the NVR it was entered for. Changing the address or the username deletes it: you'll need to type the password again.
